LAND's own 2025 dispositions: 13 farms / 12,502 acres for $95.4M = $7,631/acre weighted (mostly Mid-Atlantic + Florida + Michigan)

methodology:
LAND's 67 Schedule III line items are mapped to 16 valuation clusters by state and crop type. Each property carries an explicit per-acre fair-market value backed by 2-4 cited comparables — all dated within the last 24 months (cutoff May 2024). The "FMV by category" table at top is fully derived from this per-property analysis.

Primary comp sources, all 2024-2025 dated:
- USDA NASS 2025 Land Values Summary (published August 2025) for state-average cropland anchors
- ASFMRA California Chapter Outlook & Trends 2025 for permanent and specialty crops
- Cushman & Wakefield West Coast Ag 2024 for coastal California transactions
- State-specific industry reports (Michigan Blueberry Growers Council, Oregon Hazelnut Council, Texas A&M AgriLife, Nebraska UNL, Clemson Extension, etc.)
- LAND's own FY2025 disposition pricing ($7,631/acre weighted across 12,502 acres) as a portfolio-level reality check

Mature California permanent crops drive the bulk of the FMV-vs-book gap. LAND acquired most of its Kern / Fresno / Tulare / Madera ground in 2014-2021 at significantly lower per-acre values; California pistachio specifically has appreciated strongly. The Miscellaneous Investments aggregate row uses LAND's own 2025 disposition pricing as the most defensible mark.

The implied NAV/share at FMV deducts net debt (long-term debt + Series D Term Pref − cash) and divides by 41.44M diluted shares. Live-price discount/premium is computed against this NAV using the Yahoo quote in USD.
